Requires a login; only the public Documents lists (annual reports, concalls) were used.
No retrievable BSE/Asia Index change notices (asiaindex.co.in connection reset, BSE notices are API-driven). Rows carry only 'Nifty 50' where established; Sensex membership is not asserted.

Official current list (archives.nseindia.com) rolled back through the dated replacement table on Wikipedia (which cites NSE Indices IndexInclExcl.xls and NSE/IISL press releases); the official IndexInclExcl.xls itself and niftyindices.com press releases were unreachable (niftyindices.com timeout, web.archive.org reset). Rollback was internally consistent (50 members at every step).

gaps.scope: Universe: companies only in Sensex (never Nifty 50) 2010-2021
gaps.reason: Not identifiable without Sensex history; universe is the 85 Nifty 50 members of 2010-01..2021-09.
No dated listing reachable (BSE/NSE announcement feeds blocked); not collected.
Screener's concall list is sparse before ~2016 and gives month only (dates are YYYY-MM); pre-2016 calls exist only where a company-site archive was parsed (Wipro, Hindalco, Tech Mahindra, Grasim).
Screener lists roughly the last 13-14 reports per company; earlier reports (and their AGMs) are not listed and BSE's AR archive index is API-driven (403).

Date is the exchange file's Last-Modified (BSE bseplus / NSE archives upload); files re-stamped by later bulk re-uploads are rejected by a plausibility check (must fall in FY or FY+1) and logged as gaps.

Infosys, TCS, HUL, Nestle India, Hero MotoCorp, Zee returned 403; hcltech.com, bpcl.in, eichermotors.com, yesbank.in and bhartiairtel.in timed out/reset at time of collection; other sites were reachable but had no static, parseable results archive.
